candidate_method.aggregate: minimum anchor score across target anchors and physical channels; no candidate re-anchoring
candidate_method.anchor: target-only 4 ms pre/post RMS contrast; >= max(0.05, 0.25*target peak contrast); <=8 anchors/channel; >=12 ms separation
candidate_method.inactive_target: if no qualifying target anchors, neutral transient ratio 1.0; existing silence/activity gates remain authoritative
candidate_method.spectral_component: If target early and late high-band power fractions are both >= floor: ((candidate early_hf_fraction/candidate late_hf_fraction)/(target early_hf_fraction/target late_hf_fraction)); otherwise neutral 1.0.

compatibility.evidence: InverseValidation remains 1.0.0 but exposes exact versioned transient_method and raw component records. implementation/feature identity changes, so persisted Candidate 2.0 evidence is not reinterpreted silently.
compatibility.legacy: Old evidence retains its implementation identity and historical derivative-anchor meaning.
compatibility.validation_policy: Existing min_transient_ratio field and default 0.4 remain unchanged; only the method that produces the ratio changes.

decision_rule.confirmation: All preserved confirmation cases transient ratio >=0.4. Every damaged confirmation case ratio <0.4, except an unchanged independent hard gate may satisfy the case only if its raw measurement directly demonstrates the declared damage.
decision_rule.no_retuning: No threshold, window, cutoff, anchor rule or fixture label may change after confirmation outcomes are inspected.
decision_rule.raw_evidence: Retain baseline derivative-anchor ratio and v2 onset-contrast ratio in research evidence; production record retains all v2 anchors/components.

design_history: The v2 onset-contrast design matrix showed that normalized first-derivative spectral contrast can remain too high after onset-only low-pass damage. That design matrix is now consumed. The production candidate below replaces derivative contrast with attack-local high-band energy contrast; acceptance is decided only on the separately frozen confirmation matrix.
